_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Chloe Martin
about_me: I'm Chloe, a writer for A2 Signal, the local tech newsletter, edited by Nora Kim. I profile founders every week. I'm looking for interesting founders outside the usual software crowd.
goals: Profile ten non-software founders this semester

debriefs.text: Nora Kim, my editor, wants more Detroit coverage and more women founders.
Met Marco Bellini, chef-owner of Olive & Ash, who's opening a Detroit location. Great profile candidate.
Talked to Diego Ramirez from SoilSense, soil sensors for urban farms. He's raising a pre-seed.
Isaac Feld from A2 Launchpad offered to send me their new cohort list.
Julia Brennan runs Grown Together Detroit, the community garden network, and wants press for the spring planting day.
